40700.meaning1: analytical understanding of eloquence; discriminative knowledge of intellect

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, dhammapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, niruttipaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, paṭibhānapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, yathāvimuttaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhati.

40701.commentary: (VINa) na paṭibhānapaṭisambhidāpatto'ti yāni tāni paṭibhānasaṅkhātāni atthapaṭisambhidādīni ñāṇāni, tesu paṭisambhidāpatto na hoti. (PYt) paṭibhānapaṭisambhidāpatto'ti ettha paṭibhānaṃ nāma heṭṭhimañāṇattayam'evā'ti āha atthapaṭisambhidādīni ñāṇānī'ti, tesū'ti ñāṇesu, yaṃ yaṃ vimuttaṃ yathāvimuttaṃ, cittaṃ.

examples.text: katamehi pañcahi? atthapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, dhammapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, niruttipaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, paṭibhānapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, yāni tāni sabrahmacārīnaṃ ucc'āvacāni kiṃkaraṇīyāni tattha dakkho hoti analaso tatr'upāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ
sātiyesu anassāvī, atimāne ca no yuto, saṇho ca paṭibhānavā, na saddho na virajjati.

40704.meaning1: expressing oneself spontaneously in verse; having inspiration

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭibhānavantānaṃ yadidaṃ vaṅg'īso.

40705.commentary: (ANa) paṭibhāneyyakānan'ti satthu dhammadesanāpaṭibhānassa paccayabhūtānaṃ paṭibhānajanakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ rādhatthero aggo'ti dasseti. therassa hi diṭṭhisamudācārañ'ca okappaniyasaddhañ'ca āgamma dasabalassa navanavā dhammadesanā paṭibhāti. tasmā thero paṭibhāneyyakānaṃ aggo nāma jāto.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭibhāneyyakānaṃ yadidaṃ rādho.

40706.grammar: pr, pass of paṭibhāti, impers, trans (+acc & +gen)
40706.meaning1: comes to mind; occurs (to one about something)

examples.text: sace kho taṃ, aggivessana, jayasenassa rājakumārassa imā dve upamā paṭibhāyeyyuṃ, anacchariyaṃ te jayaseno rājakumāro pasīdeyya, pasanno ca te pasann'ākāraṃ kareyyā'ti.
ekassa'pi ce bhikkhuno na paṭibhāseyya taṃ bhikkhuniṃ apasādetuṃ, apasakka tāva bhagini, yāva bhikkhū bhuñjantī'ti, paṭidesetabbaṃ tehi bhikkhūhi
sādhu kho taṃ, āvuso isidatta, eso pañho paṭibhāsi, n'eso pañho maṃ paṭibhāsi. tenah'āvuso isidatta, yadā aññathā'pi evarūpo pañho āgaccheyya, taññ'ev'ettha paṭibhāseyyā'ti.

40709.notes: see paṭibhāsati 1. suggested reading to exaplain dative in ekassa'pi ce bhikkhuno na paṭibhāseyya

examples.text: ekassa'pi ce bhikkhuno na paṭibhāseyya taṃ bhikkhuniṃ apasādetuṃ, apasakka tāva bhagini, yāva bhikkhū bhuñjantī'ti, paṭidesetabbaṃ tehi bhikkhūhi
pubb'eva nu kho te etaṃ cetaso parivitakkitaṃ assa ye maṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ pucchissanti tes'āhaṃ evaṃ puṭṭho evaṃ byākarissāmī'ti, udāhu ṭhānaso'v'etaṃ paṭibhāseyyā'ti?

40710.meaning1: came to mind; occurred to one
40710.meaning2: came into one's mind, was evident
40710.commentary: (MNa) paṭibhaṃsū'ti paṭibhānasaṅkhātassa ñāṇassa gocarā ahesuṃ, parivitakkayitabbataṃ pāpuṇiṃsu.

examples.text: apissu maṃ, bhikkhave, imā anacchariyā gāthāyo paṭibhaṃsu pubbe assutapubbā
na hi pana taṃ, gahapati, paṭibhāsi bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ paṭipucchituṃ, kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, āturakāyo c'eva hoti āturacitto ca, kittāvatā ca pana āturakāyo hi kho hoti no ca āturacitto'ti?

40712.commentary: (DNa) paṭibhogiyā'ti veyyāvaccakarā, etassa bahū veyyāvaccakarā bhavissantī'ti attho. (DNt) paribhuñjan'aṭṭhena paṭibhogo, upayogavatthu paṭibhogo, tassa hitā'ti paṭibhogiyā.

examples.text: paṭibhogiyā manujesu idha, pubb'eva tassa abhiharanti tadā, yadi khattiyo bhavati bhūmipati, paṭihārakaṃ bahujane labhati.

40713.commentary: (MNt) paṭimaggaṃ ārohitu'kāmassā'ti āgatamaggam'eva nivattitvā gantu'kāmassa. (APt) dvayaṃ paṭimagge. paṭi abhimukhena gantabbo maggo, patho ca paṭimaggo, paṭipatho ca.

examples.text: addasaṃ virajaṃ buddhaṃ, paṭimagg'antarāpaṇe, saha disvāna sambuddhaṃ, evaṃ cintes'ahaṃ tadā.

yassa kismiñci'd'eva ṭhāne maggā ukkamma nivattitvā paṭimaggaṃ ārohitu'kāmassa sato yaṃ ṭhānaṃ manussānaṃ sappaṭibhayaṃ, purato gantvā vañcetvā evaṃ karissāmī'ti na hoti, tatth'eva maggā ukkamma nivattitvā paṭimaggaṃ ārohati, ayaṃ vaṅko nāma.
sabbe dāsakammakar'ādayo ahatavatthanivatthā gandhamāl'ādipaṭimaṇḍitā rājakule sannipatanti.

40716.meaning1: who converses; who discusses; who is skilled in dialogue

examples.text: nāgassa pantasenassa, khīṇasaṃyojanassa muttassa, paṭimantassa dhonassa, pannadhajassa vītarāgassa, dantassa nippapañcassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.
nāgassa pantasenassa, khīṇasaṃyojanassa muttassa, paṭimantakassa dhonassa, pannadhajassa vītarāgassa, dantassa nippapañcassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.
tiṭṭhatha tumhe, soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo mayā saddhiṃ paṭimantetū'ti

40721.meaning1: to argue; to discuss; to debate (with someone about something)
40721.meaning2: to argue; to discuss (with); to debate (with

examples.text: ko nu kho pahoti samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane paṭimantetun'ti?
kin'nu sīho'va nadasi, parisāyaṃ visārado, paṭimallo hi te atthi, vijitāvī nu maññasī'ti.

abhigajjam'eti paṭisūram'icchan'ti. so gajjanto uggajjanto abhigajjanto eti upeti upagacchati paṭisūraṃ paṭipurisaṃ paṭisattuṃ paṭimallaṃ icchanto sādiyanto patthayanto pihayanto abhijappanto'ti, abhigajjam'eti paṭisūram'icchaṃ.
atha kho bhagavā jivhaṃ ninnāmetvā ubho'pi kaṇṇasotāni anumasi paṭimasi, ubho'pi nāsikasotāni anumasi paṭimasi, kevalam'pi nalāṭamaṇḍalaṃ jivhāya chādesi.

40725.commentary: (PYt) paṭi punappunaṃ masiyati āmasiyatī'ti paṭimaṃso, niggahit'āgamo, bhāvappadhāno'yaṃ kammaniddeso.

examples.text: attanā coday'attānaṃ, paṭimaṃsetha attanā, so attagutto satimā, sukhaṃ bhikkhu vihāhisi.

40727.meaning1: should reproach; should reprimand; (comm) should scrutinize; should investigate

examples.text: attanā coday'attānaṃ, paṭimaṃsetha attanā, so attagutto satimā, sukhaṃ bhikkhu vihāhisi.

sakko devarājā heṭṭhā pañcasu ṭhānesu ārakkhaṃ ṭhapetvā upari devapuraṃ parivāretvā attasadisā vajirahatthā paṭimā ṭhapāpesi. asurā heṭṭhā pañca ṭhānāni paṭibāhitvā abhiruḷhā indapaṭimāyo disvā nivattitvā asurapuram'eva gacchanti.

40730.commentary: (DNt) paṭimānentī'ti patissamānasā pūjenti, bhagavantaṃ vā paṭimānāpenti paṭimānantaṃ karonti. vohāramattañ'c'etaṃ, bhagavato pana apaṭimānanā nāma n'atthi.

examples.text: amhākaṃ, bhante, dasa bhikkhū, amhākaṃ vīsati, paññāsaṃ … sataṃ dethā'ti yācitvā bhagavato'pi pattaṃ gahetvā āsanaṃ paññapetvā sakkaccaṃ piṇḍapātena paṭimānenti.
āyasmā'pi rohaṇo taṅ'khaṇaññ'eva nirodhā vuṭṭhāya saṅgho maṃ paṭimānetī'ti himavante pabbate antarahito rakkhitatale koṭisatānaṃ arahantānaṃ purato pāturahosi.
bhāriyaṃ me, mahārāja, bhātu vacanaṃ, anuḷā'pi khattiyā itthisahassaparivutā pabbajjāpurekkhārā maṃ paṭimāneti, gacchām'ahaṃ, mahārājā'ti. tena hi, amma, mahābodhiṃ gahetvā gacchāhī'ti.

40733.commentary: (DNa) paṭimānento'ti āgamento, āgamanamassa patthento udikkhanto'ti attho. (APAa) brāhmaṇe paṭimānento'ti paṭiggāhake suddhapabbajite pariyesanto.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti ukkaṭṭhāya nikkhamitvā mahatā brāhmaṇagaṇena saddhiṃ sake ārāme nisinno hoti ambaṭṭhaṃ'y'eva māṇavaṃ paṭimānento. atha kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo yena sako ārāmo tena pāyāsi.
āhutiṃ yiṭṭhu'kāmo'haṃ, paṭiyādetvāna bhojanaṃ, brāhmaṇe paṭimānento, visāle māḷake ṭhito.

40735.meaning1: tied on; strapped on; fastened; bound (by)
40735.commentary: (VINa) paṭimukkassā'ti paṭimuñcitvā ṭhitassa. upāhanāya'pi es'eva nayo. (MNa) paṭimukko'ti sīse parikkhipitvā gahito. (SNa) paṭimukk'assa mārapāso'ti assa gīvāya mārapāso paṭimukko pavesito.

examples.text: na pāduk'āruḷhassa agilānassa dhammo desetabbo. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca akkantassa vā paṭimukkassa vā omukkassa vā agilānassa dhammaṃ deseti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu baddho cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu, āvāsagato mārassa, mārassa vasaṃ gato, paṭimukk'assa mārapāso. baddho so mārabandhanena yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato.

40739.meaning1: harbours; nurses; holds onto; (comm) does not give up
40739.commentary: (SNa) sa veraṃ paṭimuñcatī'ti so evarūpo gaṇṭhikaṃ paṭimuñcanto viya taṃ veraṃ attani paṭimuñcati ṭhapeti, na paṭinissajjatī'ti attho.

examples.text: accayaṃ desayantīnaṃ, yo ce na paṭigaṇhati, kop'antaro dosagaru, sa veraṃ paṭimuñcatī'ti.
yo ve dassanti vatvāna, adāne kurute mano, bhūmyaṃ so patitaṃ pāsaṃ, gīvāyaṃ paṭimuñcati.

40742.meaning1: tying on; strapping on; fastening; binding

40743.meaning2: put on a dress, fastened, bound

40744.meaning1: (of clothes or shoes) having put on; having dressed oneself (in)
40744.meaning2: having put on a dress, having fastened, having bound

40745.commentary: (DNa) osadhīnaṃ paṭimokkho'ti khār'ādīni datvā tadanurūpe vaṇe gate tesaṃ apanayanaṃ.

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… kaṇṇatelaṃ nettatappanaṃ natthukammaṃ añjanaṃ paccañjanaṃ sālākiyaṃ sallakattiyaṃ dārakatikicchā mūlabhesajjānaṃ anuppadānaṃ osadhīnaṃ paṭimokkho

40746.synonym: abhisaṅkhata, upakkhaṭa, paññatta, parikappita, parikammakata, vinīta, vihita, sajjita

examples.text: atha kho rājā korabyo yaṃ tattha khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyattaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ vissajjethā'ti vatvā bhadrāni bhadrāni yānāni yojāpetvā bhadraṃ yānaṃ abhiruhitvā bhadrehi bhadrehi yānehi thullakoṭṭhikamhā niyyāsi mahaccarājānubhāvena āyasmantaṃ raṭṭhapālaṃ dassanāya.
tena kho pana samayena aññatarena brāhmaṇena saṅghassa payopānaṃ paṭiyattaṃ hoti. bhikkhū surusurukārakaṃ khīraṃ pivanti.
rājā kira pasenadi kosalo ekasmiṃ chaṇadivase alaṅ'katapaṭiyattaṃ sabbasetaṃ ekaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ nāma hatthiṃ abhiruyha mahantena rāj'ānubhāvena nagaraṃ padakkhiṇaṃ karoti
paheṇak'atthāya vā pātheyy'atthāya vā paṭiyattasesakaṃ denti, gamane paṭippassaddhe denti, ñātakānaṃ pavāritānaṃ, aññass'atthāya, attano dhanena, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

40751.grammar: abs of caus of pati √yat, caus, trans (+acc)

examples.text: atha kho brahm'āyu brāhmaṇo tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi, kālo, bho gotama, niṭṭhitaṃ bhattan'ti.
atha kho so gopālako tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane pahūtaṃ app'odakapāyasaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā navañ'ca sappiṃ bhagavato kālaṃ ārocesi, kālo, bhante, niṭṭhitaṃ bhattan'ti.

40754.synonym: upakappeti, kappeti, pakappeti, paripāceti, vidahati, saṃvidahati

examples.text: keṇiyo pana jaṭilo sāmaṃ'y'eva maṇḍalamālaṃ paṭiyādeti.
rañño kira vappamaṅgaladivaso nāma hoti, tadā anekappakāraṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādenti.

kiñci bahiddhā cintanaṃ nāma na cintesi. mahā-upāsikā'pi dibbena cakkhunā olokentī theraṃ disvā, idāni ovādadāyakaṃ ācariyaṃ labhitvā pun'āgato mama putto'ti attano ñāṇen'eva paricchinditvā tassa sappāy'āhāraṃ paṭiyādetvā adāsi.

addasā kho selo brāhmaṇo keṇiyassa jaṭilassa assame app'ekacce uddhanāni khaṇante, app'ekacce kaṭṭhāni phālente, app'ekacce bhājanāni dhovante, app'ekacce udakamaṇikaṃ patiṭṭhāpente, app'ekacce āsanāni paññapente, keṇiyaṃ pana jaṭilaṃ sāmaṃ'y'eva maṇḍalamālaṃ paṭiyādentaṃ.

40761.meaning1: opposing king; royal enemy; royal adversary

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho rājānaṃ pasenadiṃ kosalaṃ bhagavā etadavoca, kiṃ nu te, mahārāja, rājā vā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro kupito vesālikā vā licchavī aññe vā paṭirājāno'ti?

40762.synonym: atthika, anukūla, anucchavi, anucchavika, anurūpa, anulomika, upiya, kappa, tajja, tathārūpa, tadanurūpa, patirūpī, pattayutta, yuttaka, yuttarūpa, sāmaggiya, sāmīcika, sāruppa
40762.commentary: (DNa) patirūpadesavāso'ti yattha catasso parisā sandissanti, evarūpe anucchavike dese vāso.

examples.text: paṭirūpadesavāso ca, pubbe ca katapuññatā, attasammāpaṇidhi ca, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.

40763.meaning1: resembling; disguised as; in the appearance of
40763.meaning2: resembling, disguised as, in the appearance of

40765.meaning1: living in a suitable place; dwelling in an appropriate region
40765.commentary: (DNa) patirūpadesavāso'ti yattha catasso parisā sandissanti, evarūpe anucchavike dese vāso.

examples.text: paṭirūpadesavāso ca, pubbe ca katapuññatā, attasammāpaṇidhi ca, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.

40766.meaning1: gets angry back; also gets angry; responds angrily (to)

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭiseneti? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu akkosantaṃ paccakkosati, rosantaṃ paṭirosati, bhaṇḍantaṃ paṭibhaṇḍati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭiseneti.

40767.meaning1: gets angry back; also gets angry; responds angrily (to)

examples.text: yo kho, brāhmaṇa, akkosantaṃ paccakkosati, rosentaṃ paṭiroseti, bhaṇḍantaṃ paṭibhaṇḍati, ayaṃ vuccati, brāhmaṇa, sambhuñjati vītiharatī'ti. te mayaṃ tayā n'eva sambhuñjāma na vītiharāma.

40768.meaning2: having obtained, having received, having gotten

examples.text: aṭṭh'ime, bhikkhave, hetū aṭṭha paccayā ādibrahmacariyikāya paññāya appaṭiladdhāya paṭilābhāya, paṭiladdhāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattanti. katame aṭṭha?
pubbe vā paṭiladdhapubbaṃ atītaṃ niruddhaṃ vipariṇataṃ samanussarato uppajjati somanassaṃ. yaṃ evarūpaṃ somanassaṃ idaṃ vuccati gehasitaṃ somanassaṃ.

cakkhuviññeyyānaṃ rūpānaṃ iṭṭhānaṃ kantānaṃ manāpānaṃ manoramānaṃ lok'āmisapaṭisaṃyuttānaṃ paṭilābhaṃ vā paṭilābhato samanupassato pubbe vā paṭiladdhapubbaṃ atītaṃ niruddhaṃ vipariṇataṃ samanussarato uppajjati somanassaṃ.

40771.meaning1: having gained faith; having become inspired
40771.meaning2: having acquired faith; having gained confidence

examples.text: taṃ dhammaṃ suṇāti gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aññatarasmiṃ vā kule paccājāto. so taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā tathāgate saddhaṃ paṭilabhati.

yattha pana mahantaṃ paribhavaṃ paṭilabhati, tattha ciram'pi vasati. so nivatth'avatthe jiṇṇe pilotikakhaṇḍena tasmim'pi jiṇṇe kenaci dinnaṃ aggaṇhanto hirikopīna-paṭicchādana-matten'eva carati. evaṃ gacchante kāle ekaṃ nigamagāmaṃ agamāsi.
pubbe kho ahaṃ, āvuso, agāriyabhūto samāno aviddasu ahosiṃ. tassa me tathāgato vā tathāgatasāvako vā dhammaṃ desesi. t'āhaṃ dhammaṃ sutvā tathāgate saddhaṃ paṭilabhiṃ.

atha kho āyasmato ānandassa etadahosi, mā h'evaṃ kho uttiyo paribbājako pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ paṭilabhi, sabbasāmukkaṃsikaṃ vata me samaṇo gotamo pañhaṃ puṭṭho saṃsādeti, no vissajjeti, na nūna visahatī'ti.

40777.meaning2: having obtained, having received, having gotten

examples.text: mahāsatto… aniccatāmanasikāramukhena sabbabhavesu abhivaḍḍhamānasaṃvego kāye ca asubhasaññaṃ paṭilabhitvā ghar'āvāsa-palibodh'ādhibhūtaṃ kilesagahanaṃ anogāhetvā'va
aññass'atthāya karoti vā kārāpeti vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa. aññena kataṃ paṭilabhitvā paribhuñjati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

40779.commentary: (VINa) paṭilātaṃ ukkhipatī'ti dayhamānaṃ alātaṃ patitaṃ ukkhipati, puna yathāṭhāne ṭhapetī'ti attho. evaṃ avijjhātaṃ ukkhipitvā pakkhipantass'eva dukkaṭaṃ, vijjhātaṃ puna jālāpentassa pācittiyam'eva.

examples.text: paṭilātaṃ ukkhipati, āpatti dukkaṭassa. gilāno agilānasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
sukhaṃ yāva jarā sīlaṃ, sukhā saddhā patiṭṭhitā, sukho paññāya paṭilābho, pāpānaṃ akaraṇaṃ sukhaṃ.
so mah'iccho samāno vighātavā asantuṭṭho itarītara-cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārena pāpikaṃ icchaṃ paṇidahati anavaññappaṭilābhāya lābhasakkārasilokappaṭilābhāya

40781.meaning1: time when getting; time of receiving (of)

40782.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of paṭilābha
40782.meaning2: as personal acquisition; as obtaining; as gain
40782.commentary: (DNt) paṭilābhato samanupassato'ti aho mayā imāni laddhānī'ti yathāladdhāni rūp'ārammaṇ'ādīni assādayato.

examples.text: tattha katamāni cha gehasitāni somanassāni? cakkhuviññeyyānaṃ rūpānaṃ iṭṭhānaṃ kantānaṃ manāpānaṃ manoramānaṃ lok'āmisapaṭisaṃyuttānaṃ paṭilābhaṃ vā paṭilābhato samanupassato

40785.meaning1: regarding the obtaining; related to the acquiring; about gaining (of)

examples.text: katame cattāro? idha, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa oram'bhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni appahīnāni honti, upapattipaṭilābhiyāni saṃyojanāni appahīnāni honti, bhavapaṭilābhiyāni saṃyojanāni appahīnāni honti.
sambādhe vata okāsaṃ, avindi bhūrimedhaso, yo jhānam'abujjhi buddho, paṭilīnanisabho munī'ti.

40788.meaning1: solitary chief bull; lone alpha bull; secluded leader of men; (comm) leader who has removed conceit

examples.text: sambādhe vata okāsaṃ, avindi bhūrimedhaso, yo jhānam'abujjhi buddho, paṭilīnanisabho munī'ti.

40792.meaning2: having drawn back, having kept away from

40793.commentary: (SNa) paṭileṇissāmī'ti-ādīsu agge paharitvā kappāsavaṭṭiṃ viya nāmento niyyāsavaṭṭiṃ viya ca ekato katvā alliyāpento paṭileṇeti nāma.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, satti tiṇhaphalā. atha puriso āgaccheyya, ahaṃ imaṃ sattiṃ tiṇhaphalaṃ pāṇinā vā muṭṭhinā vā paṭileṇissāmi paṭikoṭṭissāmi paṭivaṭṭessāmī'ti.
taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, bhabbo nu kho so puriso amuṃ sattiṃ tiṇhaphalaṃ pāṇinā vā muṭṭhinā vā paṭileṇetuṃ paṭikoṭṭetuṃ paṭivaṭṭetun'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

40795.commentary: (NIDD2a) paṭilomavuttino'ti paccanīkaṃ kathanasīlā, paṭimallā hutvā pavattantī'ti attho.

examples.text: buddhānaṃ sāvakānaṃ vacanaṃ byappathaṃ desanaṃ anusiṭṭhiṃ na ādiyanti na sussusanti, na sotaṃ odahanti, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapenti, anassavā avacanakarā paṭilomavuttino, aññen'eva mukhaṃ karonti.

40797.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of paṭiloma
40797.meaning1: in reverse order; backwards; against the grain

examples.text: yato kho, ānanda, bhikkhu ime aṭṭha vimokkhe anulomam'pi samāpajjati, paṭilomam'pi samāpajjati, anulomapaṭilomam'pi samāpajjati, yatth'icchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ yāvat'icchakaṃ samāpajjati'pi vuṭṭhāti'pi.
